note.question: How should a live-streaming commerce platform jointly allocate product positions and design product information to maximize advertising revenue from privately informed sellers?
note.overview: Privately informed sellers report types to a platform that jointly chooses ad positions, product information and payments. The platform designs a direct mechanism subject to dominant-strategy incentive compatibility and individual rationality, making this a substantive auction and mechanism-design paper.

components.label: Model sequence and system structure
components.explanation: The platform commits to a direct mechanism specifying position allocation, seller payments and information provision. Each seller observes its type and reports it. The mechanism chooses the ordered ad allocation and information signals; a consumer then inspects ads in cascade order, decides whether to purchase or continue, and seller payments are realized. Position affects traffic intensity, whereas information affects both conditional purchase probability and per-purchase revenue.
